## Role and prompt

Implement app.py, requirements.txt and .gitignore from docs/SPEC.md and docs/DESIGN.md. Support startup before UI files exist. Enforce symbol/date/quantity validation, integer paise, one pending order, next-open settlement, cash gap rejection, benchmark and persistence. Smoke-test setup and create/advance using isolated SQLite. Leave UI implementation to the next phase.

Use docs/SPEC.md as the source of truth. Report files changed, verification and blockers briefly.
